status: Directly inspected development views; complete pump and installation not accepted
originals_compared: HB196/199 originals MarkVIII099/100 for subsequent mounting

observations.isometric.png: Separate upper filter with open gauze, central neck and retaining nut follows the broad source arrangement. Conical cap, aperture pitch, spoke/post proportions and neck heights remain estimates; true weave is absent.
observations.cutaway.png: Two lower pressure gears below three upper scavenge gears, common spindle, separate lower filter and mushroom relief components are visible. This is selective removal of castings/filters for display; internal parts remain whole. Drain hardware is removed with its cut-away cover region to avoid a misleading detached appearance.
observations.gear_core.png: Five gears, steel partition, two idler pins and two shaft bushes agree with source component arrangement. Tooth count, involute profile, depths and shaft lobes remain inferred.
observations.exploded.png: Upper filter, upper casing, paired lower filter/cover and two gear levels compare with LIB33 and SNL33. Offsets are solely a review illustration and are not asserted service movements.
observations.relief.png: Seat, mushroom valve/stem, helical spring, selected shim and three-window cage are individually visible. Detailed cast/thread forms and spring rates are not source-established.
